topic: Unanswered Instagram DMs: Rs 60,000/month lost (artificial jewellery)
lines: Sath hazaar rupay aapke Instagram DMs mein pade hain.
Customer ne likha: jhumka ka price? Aapne agle din reply kiya.
Tab tak woh kisi aur se order kar chuki thi.
Roz paanch aise DMs, har order par chaar sau rupay, mahine ke sath hazaar.
Auto reply laga lo: price, catalogue, order link, teen second mein.
Aap sote raho, DMs sale banate rahein.
Yeh reel kisi seller ko bhejein.
DMs sale banana hai? Comment REPLY.
